name: Prime Closet Shelf Wood (Brush)
intent: Brush one coat of acrylic wood primer on bare shelves. Fires only when substrate_state is SS_BARE. Brush application fills grain better than spray for closet-scale work and avoids spray gear setup for a single shelf area.
doctrine: Rate mirrors trim brush primer pace (~80 LF/hr). Material system reference: SYS_PRIMER_WOOD_ACRYLIC (registered in id_registry). Primer is always brushed on closet shelves regardless of finish method — see design doc §3.7.
